specification_gaps.message: Owner: Performance + Memory + Launch Time Design. Article 31 calibration is missing for all eight Task 15 performance cells: device floor, OS, build configuration, representative data scale, warm/cold state, measurement tool, percentile/maximum, regression threshold, and the Motion display refresh target. Closure requires owner-approved calibrated records in docs/constitution/performance-budgets.json linked to these specifications plus current physical-device measurements tied to commit and environment. Until closure, the specifications cannot authorize implementation or support Spec Ready, performance, energy, haptic-device, or physical-device Green claims.
VSP-01 governs Search placement only; no approved Search-overlay package is mapped, so Search implementation and visual proof remain absent.
